redirectURL.description: The URL to redirect the customer once the customer has edited the connection through the Connect AI UI. This URL maps to the **Return to** button on the **Edit Connection** page in the Connect AI UI.

name.description: (Optional) If provided, the connection name. By default, this is a suggested default that the end user can change on the **Edit Connection** form. Set `editableName` to `false` to lock the field and enforce the supplied value server-side.

editableName.description: (Optional) The default value is `true`. When `true`, any `name` you supply is shown as a suggested default value, and the end user can change it. When `false`, the **Connection Name** field is rendered read-only, and the server enforces the supplied `name` on submit. Has no effect when `name` is omitted.
